objections: Rare-category merging at minGroup=10 destroys the labelled C1 signal: the phishing domain nimbus-docs-share.example has only 9 rows and the exfil domain upload.nimbusdrive.example 1 row, so both become 'other' and the campaign is no longer detectable, contrary to the scenario note.
It also does not achieve its privacy aim: health, pharmacy, union and job-search domains (ajanvaraus.terveyspalvelu, apteekki, liitto, tyopaikat) each have 100+ rows and survive the merge unchanged.

With client_ip and client_hostname suppressed, queried names cannot be attributed to an employee, so keeping the column discloses little beyond what the chosen recipe already keeps while preserving the campaign domains.
